name: EventName
definition: Name of a student-club event.

name: EventStatus
definition: Status code of an event (e.g. Closed).

name: EventAttendance
definition: Count of members attending an event.

name: EventType
definition: Category/type code of an event.

name: ExpenseDescription
definition: Description/type of an expense line.

name: ExpenseDate
definition: Date on which an expense was incurred.

name: ExpenseCost
definition: Monetary cost of an expense line.

name: ExpenseApproved
definition: Approval indicator for an expense.

name: BudgetAmount
definition: Budgeted amount for an event/category.

name: BudgetSpend
definition: Actual amount spent against a budget line.

name: BudgetVariance
definition: Difference between budget and actual spend (negative means over budget).

name: BudgetCategory
definition: Category code of a budget line (e.g. Advertisement).

name: MemberPhone
definition: Phone number of a club member.

name: MemberMajor
definition: Academic major of a club member.

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: T-shirt size of a club member.

name: MemberPosition
definition: Position held by a member in the student club.

name: MemberState
definition: State where a member grew up.

name: CityName
definition: Name of a city.

name: SpendToBudgetRatio
definition: Actual spend divided by budgeted amount. Formula: BudgetSpend / BudgetAmount. Inputs: BudgetSpend = tab05.fld023; BudgetAmount = tab05.fld021

name: BudgetOverspend
definition: Amount by which actual spend exceeds budget. Formula: BudgetSpend - BudgetAmount. Inputs: BudgetSpend = tab05.fld023; BudgetAmount = tab05.fld021

name: AverageExpenseCost
definition: Mean cost across expense lines. Formula: AVG(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = tab06.fld028

name: TotalExpenseCost
definition: Sum of expense costs. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = tab06.fld028

name: ExpenseAboveAverage
definition: Expense lines whose cost exceeds the overall average. Formula: ExpenseCost > AVG(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = tab06.fld028

name: EventSpendToBudgetRatio
definition: Per-event spend divided by per-event budget. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpend) / SUM(BudgetAmount). Inputs: BudgetSpend = tab05.fld023; BudgetAmount = tab05.fld021

name: EventTotalCost
definition: Total expense cost incurred for an event. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = tab06.fld028

name: MonthlyExpenseTotal
definition: Total expense cost within a calendar month. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost) grouped by month(ExpenseDate). Inputs: ExpenseCost = tab06.fld028; ExpenseDate = tab06.fld027

name: MediumShirtMemberCount
definition: Count of members whose t-shirt size is Medium. Formula: COUNT(*) WHERE MemberTShirtSize = 'Medium'. Inputs: MemberTShirtSize = tab08.fld039 WHERE fld039 = 'Medium'

name: EventAttendanceCount
definition: Number of members attending an event. Formula: COUNT(EventAttendance). Inputs: EventAttendance = tab01.fld001

name: EventStatus
definition: Classifies events by lifecycle status such as Closed.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: Categories used to classify budget lines.

name: TShirtSize
definition: T-shirt sizes worn by members.
